summary_en: Adapts transfer-learning-based full waveform inversion to shallow, small-scale acoustic detection of underwater buried targets. The method is pretrained and fine-tuned on large simulated datasets and evaluated on numerical simulations and field-test data, with the publisher reporting lower computational time and reduced sidelobe metrics compared with conventional FWI under the tested iterative schemes.
